title: Combined Boolean predicate
statement: For a Boolean-valued nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ and natural numbers $d,c,A,a$, define a predicate on Boolean lists $y$ that is true exactly when $	ext{initB}(N,d,c,A,a,y)$ and $	ext{accB}(N,d,c,A,a,y)$ are both true, and at least one of $	ext{baseB}(N,d,c,A,a,y)$ and $	ext{orB}(A,a,y)$ is true.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include definitions of initB, accB, baseB, or orB, so their meanings cannot be expanded further.
